command:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$taskOutput = '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-M02-new-r2-v2'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'draft-02.md') -Destination (Join-Path $taskOutput 'final.md') -ErrorAction Stop
$finalHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'final.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
$draftHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'draft-02.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
$taskText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $taskOutput 'final.md'), [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
$bodyText = (($taskText -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { -not $_.StartsWith('#') }) -join [Environment]::NewLine
$bodyCount = [regex]::Matches($bodyText, "\b[^\W_]+(?:['’\-][^\W_]+)*\b").Count
$loadedResources = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'loaded-resources.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$taskInputs = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'task-input-hashes.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$resourceResults = @($loadedResources.resources + $loadedResources.generated_support_resources + $taskInputs.inputs | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path = $_.path; hash_matches = ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -eq $_.sha256) } })
$requiredNames = @('draft-01.md','draft-02.md','self-review.md','final.md','rationale.md','note.md','loaded-resources.json','task-input-hashes.json','executed-commands.json','draft-01-checks.json','draft-02-checks.json','draft-01-check_voice.stdout.txt','draft-01-check_prose.stdout.txt','draft-02-check_voice.stdout.txt','draft-02-check_prose.stdout.txt')
$missing = @($requiredNames | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $taskOutput $_)) })
$verification = [ordered]@{
  final_sha256 = $finalHash
  final_matches_revised_draft = ($finalHash -eq $draftHash)
  body_words_excluding_attribution_heading = $bodyCount
  within_requested_range = ($bodyCount -ge 350 -and $bodyCount -le 450)
  unicode_replacement_characters = [regex]::Matches($taskText, [string][char]0xFFFD).Count
  attribution_heading_count = @($taskText -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { $_.StartsWith('#') }).Count
  missing_required_files = $missing
  resource_hash_checks = $resourceResults
}
$verificationJson = $verification | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $taskOutput 'final-verification.json'), $verificationJson + [Environment]::NewLine, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$verificationJson
if ($finalHash -ne $draftHash -or $bodyCount -lt 350 -or $bodyCount -gt 450 -or $missing.Count -gt 0 -or @($resourceResults | Where-Object { -not $_.hash_matches }).Count -gt 0) { exit 1 }
